description: Check an x402 payment request before your agent pays it. One call screens the payTo address against official sanctions lists (OFAC SDN digital currency addresses), checks that the asset is the official USDC contract and the network is Base, compares the price with the seller's Bazaar catalogue listing and, with seller_name, screens the company against US, UK, EU and Canadian sanctions lists. Returns allow / review / block with reasons, the hash of the exact invoice checked and an Ed25519-signed receipt valid 10 minutes. Keep it as proof of the check if a payment is ever disputed. Input: requirements (one entry of the 402 accepts array) or payment_required (the full 402 body), optional seller_name and seller_country. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/payment-check with an x402 client.

requirements.description: One entry of the accepts array from the seller's 402 response

amount.description: Amount in atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals)

asset.description: Token contract address the seller asks for

network.description: Network of the invoice, e.g. eip155:8453 (Base)

payTo.description: Seller wallet address that would receive the payment

seller_country.description: Optional ISO-2 country code of the seller

seller_name.description: Optional: seller company name, screened against sanctions lists
